# ETL failure 2026-10-02

The nightly ETL job failed on 2026-10-02. An upstream producer added a field, the consumer contract rejected it, and the load stopped at the first non-null violation.

## Fix
Published schema registry v2 and pinned producers to it. The job re-ran clean on 2026-10-03.

## Facts
- Symptom: consumer contract rejection, non-null violation on the new field
- Root cause: schema drift
- Fix: schema registry v2
- Owner: Carol, data engineer on platform squad 4
